Good work! Normally when you board a ship, you will be presented with options: Capture Ship, Leave, or steal Cargo, Fuel, Credits, or Ammo. The probability of capturing the ship is also presented in the form of a percentage. This is determined by the difference in sizes of the ship's crews. A larger ship is more likely to be able to capture a smaller ship. However, when you steal one or more of the items above, your chances of capturing the ship decrease. When you are ready to continue training, restock your ship and return to the Spaceport Bar.
